findings.title: Plugin request completion logs lose traceID field
findings.body: Previously, logRequest appended traceID from tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false) to logParams and imported pkg/infra/tracing. That field and import are removed here. The new ContextualLoggerMiddleware/instrumentContext only adds endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID and uname; it does not add traceID, and m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info has no inherent way to recover it. As a result, every "Plugin Request Completed" log loses trace correlation. If this was not intentional, traceID should be added to the contextual attributes or kept in logParams.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards original logger so log assertions are lost
findings.body: LoggerMiddleware.logRequest now logs through m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info. TestLogger.FromContext returns NewTestLogger() instead of returning f or a logger sharing f's Logs. Any test that passes a *TestLogger to NewLoggerMiddleware and then inspects InfoLogs/Calls or Message against that original TestLogger will see zero values, because the actual log was recorded on a fresh, inaccessible TestLogger. Returning f, or otherwise sharing the same counters, would preserve the previous assertion behavior.

findings.title: Adding FromContext to Logger is a source-breaking interface change
findings.body: Logger is a public interface in pkg/plugins/log. Adding FromContext(ctx context.Context) Logger forces every implementation and mock of Logger to implement the new method. This diff updates TestLogger and grafanaInfraLogWrapper, but any other implementation in the repository or any external consumer of this package will fail to compile. If backward compatibility matters, keep Logger unchanged and define a separate optional interface such as ContextualLogger that LoggerMiddleware can type-assert.

findings.title: No tests cover the new contextual logger behavior
findings.body: The PR adds ContextualLoggerMiddleware and changes LoggerMiddleware to obtain pluginId, endpoint, user and datasource fields from FromContext(ctx) instead of passing them explicitly. The only test change in the diff renames the metrics test to use newMetricsMiddleware; there is no test that verifies QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth or CollectMetrics adds the expected contextual attributes, nor that LoggerMiddleware actually emits those fields in the completion log. A middleware ordering or context-propagation mistake would not be caught.
